framework_outcome_note: TDG is structurally the ANTI-PATTERN for J-Book Exposure Divergence. The 10-K names NO specific Program Elements, NO specific named DoD programs of record, NO single platform contributing >10% of revenue. Defense revenue is 43% of FY22 net sales but is distributed across ~100 manufacturing facilities and ~100,000 installed-base aircraft via aftermarket. usaspending corroborates this: 2,491 DoD contract awards in PIT window summing to ~$64.6M, spread across dozens of TDG subsidiaries (AeroControlex, Skurka Aerospace, Whippany Actuation Systems, etc.), with no single award resembling a program-of-record concentration. pentagon_jbook returns NOT_FOUND for contractor 'TransDigm' — corpus is YSS/IONQ-style small-cap-PE-concentration focused and TDG is not indexed. The DIVERGENCE pattern (named PE → unfunded) cannot fire on a filing that names no PE; the framework correctly returns PASS / UNVERIFIABLE across J-Book-grounded claims. This is the desired null result for a diversified-aftermarket defense supplier — NOT a missed signal.
